verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party Settings → Plans & credit usage page where users can see their credit balance, track usage, and manage top-ups. Plan tiers are mentioned only in passing: a free plan, Business/Enterprise gating for API keys, and enterprise features. missing for 10: documented per-action credit costs (e.g., what a Build-mode message or deep scan consumes), a clear breakdown of what each plan includes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of credit transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes

citations.quote: Use Settings → Plans & credit usage to understand your credit balance, track credit usage, add credits, and manage top-ups.
Lovable automatically creates your first personal workspace on the free plan
Executing requests needs a workspace API key, which requires a Business or Enterprise plan.
